mapper.select: INSERT INTO food_item (food_name, storage_type, category, quantity_text, expired_at, purchased_at, opened_at, frozen_at, source_type, freeze_type, status, memo, created_at, updated_at, capacity_text, source_memo, sell_by_at) VALUES (#{foodName}, #{storageType}, #{category,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{quantityText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expiredAt,jdbcType=DATE}, #{purchasedAt,jdbcType=DATE}, #{openedAt,jdbcType=DATE}, #{frozenAt,jdbcType=DATE}, #{sourceType}, #{freezeType}, #{status}, #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{capacityText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sourceMemo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sellByAt,jdbcType=DATE}) RETURNING food_id

SELECT food_id, food_name, storage_type, category, quantity_text, expired_at, purchased_at, opened_at, frozen_at, source_type, freeze_type, status, memo, created_at, updated_at, capacity_text, source_memo, sell_by_at FROM food_item WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC, food_id DESC

SELECT food_id, food_name, storage_type, category, quantity_text, expired_at, purchased_at, opened_at, frozen_at, source_type, freeze_type, status, memo, created_at, updated_at, capacity_text, source_memo, sell_by_at FROM food_item WHERE food_id = #{id}
